verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's own documented capabilities let users pull data out: persistent files can be read without resuming compute (docs-7), files can be copied out with standard SSH/`scp` (docs-17), and historical logs, metrics and the audit ledger are readable via APIs (docs-19). Templates also build on standard public or private container images, which limits lock-in (docs-24). However, nothing describes a bulk or account-wide export, and nothing confirms snapshots or RootFS can be exported in an open format, so 'export all of my data and leave' is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented bulk/account-level data export, snapshot/RootFS export in open formats (e.g. OCI/tar), explicit offboarding or data-portability documentation, independent corroboration.
